cases.customer_question: Can Bluetooth SIG product publication be delayed after qualification submission and registration?
question_variants: Can product visibility be postponed after SIG registration?
How long can publication be delayed?
Can unpublished products stay hidden after qualification?
Can product release timing control SIG listing visibility?
Can publication be synchronized with product launch?
cases.actual_issue: The product was still confidential and not publicly announced, so the customer needed to delay public visibility of the Bluetooth SIG listing after qualification completion.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer wanted to finish Bluetooth qualification before publicly announcing the product. They needed to know whether the Bluetooth SIG database could keep the product hidden temporarily after registration. The consultant clarified the allowed publication delay limits.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that the product publication timing can be specified during registration. Under the then-current process, the publication date could be delayed up to 90 days after registration, and changes were generally not allowed after submission. The consultant later confirmed that a January qualification completion with April publication timing was feasible if qualification fee payment and evidence delivery were completed in time.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth SIG Qualification Workspace allows a configurable Product Publication Date separate from the qualification completion date, but only within the allowed maximum delay window.
cases.final_recommendation: Complete qualification early if needed, but configure the Product Publication Date during submission to align with the planned product announcement timeline and ensure qualification fee payment is completed before registration deadlines.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: If publication timing is configured incorrectly, confidential product details may become publicly visible before launch, or the company may miss the intended release schedule due to publication date restrictions.
